children: Long-term Japanese government bond yields are lower as haven demand for bonds increases amid renewed selloffs in semiconductor and other artificial intelligence-related stocks. Recent declines in crude oil prices have also lessened expectations for the Bank of Japan's fast-paced rate increases in the near term. Investors will be focusing on U.S. personal consumption expenditures price data due later Wednesday and their implications for the Fed's policy-making. The 10-year JGB yield is down 3.0 basis points to 2.690% and the 2-year yield is 2 basis points lower at 1.755%. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
